summary: Verified the kpwk8ol3 broken-image fix and the new barsaat reels block. The Barsaat page renders the new <barsaat-reels-section> with exactly 2 reel tiles (barsaat-reel-0, barsaat-reel-1) whose <video> src match the spec; both video URLs return 200/206 with content-type: video/mp4 on HEAD. context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright/Chromium headless that ships with Emergent automation does NOT include proprietary codecs (H.264/AAC), so <video> with .MP4 sources always reports readyState=0 and MediaError code 4 (SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED) in this environment. Do NOT treat this as an app bug — verify videos by (a) reading the <video src> attribute, (b) HEAD-fetching the URL and confirming 200 + content-type: video/mp4, and (c) confirming the URL matches the expected asset. The two Barsaat reel URLs verified this run: pampvqbe_Barssat%20Reel%202.MP4 (200, 11.7MB) and l41d744x_biraajo%206th%20june%2000097020_prob4.mp4 (200, 32.3MB).
